name: Dance of Bloody Ink
text:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon that bears a rune.

---
As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target's flesh. You Invoke a Rune on a melee weapon you are wielding and Strike. Then, you can Step and Strike again with the same weapon. If the second Strike hits, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
